access_links.label: KiwiRail Tunnels (WFS)
access_links.note: Alternate-format item metadata agrees on publisher and resource scope. Distribution content was not downloaded or compared.

access_note: Public metadata was readable without authentication. Data queries, download access and service operation were not tested. The source states Creative Commons Attribution 4.0, with accuracy and completeness caveats.
description: KiwiRail represents each rail tunnel as a single polyline along the Main Left or Up Main track centreline, from asset start to end. Attributes identify tunnel number, line name, tunnel name, asset identifier and midpoint coordinates. The provider limits this geometry to mapping and excludes survey-accurate design or elevation use. Feature-service and WFS listings describe the same resource. Tunnel condition, bore cross-section and capacity are not established by the inspected metadata. Coverage is New Zealand. Access is through the published ArcGIS feature service and alternate item listings. Licence and cost: The source states Creative Commons Attribution 4.0, with accuracy and completeness caveats. Caveats: only item, service and layer metadata were inspected. No feature records were downloaded, and current completeness, geometric quality and operational availability remain untested. Access charges are not stated in the inspected metadata. The resource provides mapped infrastructure or service inputs; applying it in a simulation requires checking the source limits and relevant model assumptions. Related resources include the existing KiwiRail network-risk and freight-disruption layers.
